metadata.name: p1-mobile-focus-warm-return-cache-neutral-scene-readiness
metadata.description: Diagnostic reference-scale 390x844 Focus→Goals→Focus warm-return sequence. Reuses the existing useful-data/readiness, resource timing, Service Worker and overlapping Long Task probe; counts/times only 32x8 panorama sample canvas drawImage/getImageData calls per route mount, but does not require canvas reads because valid warmed scene data may be memoized. Each route is ready only after its exact route content is visible and its ObservatoryScene inline day/night/aspect CSS values remain stable across two animation frames. Restores instrumentation and captures the warm Focus page with normal art. Uses the separate reference-scale setup case in the same routed lease. No app preference, business state or source changes; not a production/mobile-device latency gate.

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const p=window.__plannerWarmReturnProbe; let swTimer; if(p.serviceWorkerPromise) await Promise.race([p.serviceWorkerPromise,new Promise(resolve=>{swTimer=setTimeout(()=>{p.serviceWorker.read_timed_out=true;resolve();},500);})]); if(swTimer)clearTimeout(swTimer); for(const entry of p.longObserver?.takeRecords()??[])p.longTasks.push({start_ms:entry.startTime,duration_ms:entry.duration}); const result={transition_count:p.transitions.length,transitions:p.transitions.map(({key,route,status,ready_condition,ready_ms,error_ms,error_text,sample_complete_ms,raf_checks,canvas_ops,scene_css_ready,scene_css_stable_frames,scene_css_values})=>({key,route,status,ready_condition,ready_ms,error_ms,error_text,scene_css_ready:scene_css_ready===true,scene_css_stable_frames,scene_css_values,sample_complete_after_click_ms:sample_complete_ms,canvas_samples_observed:canvas_ops.some(x=>x.method==='getImageData'&&x.ok),raf_readiness_checks:raf_checks??0,canvas_counts:{drawImage:canvas_ops.filter(x=>x.method==='drawImage'&&x.ok).length,getImageData:canvas_ops.filter(x=>x.method==='getImageData'&&x.ok).length}})),observer_available:p.observerAvailable,service_worker:p.serviceWorker,scene_preferences:p.prefs,normal_art_observed:!p.prefs.art_free&&!p.prefs.reduced_scenery}; p.cleanup(); const cleanup={cleanup_done:p.cleanupDone,drawImage_restored:CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.drawImage===p.originals.drawImage,getImageData_restored:CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.getImageData===p.originals.getImageData}; if(!cleanup.cleanup_done||!cleanup.drawImage_restored||!cleanup.getImageData_restored)throw new Error('canvas instrumentation cleanup did not restore original prototypes'); result.instrumentation_cleanup=cleanup; return result; })()
